data.name: Muaath
data.long_meaning:
From the Arabic root 'A-TH-R' meaning to seek or pursue, Muaath is the one who is constantly in search of truth.

In Islamic history, Muaath ibn Jabal was a companion of the Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) and played a significant role in spreading Islam.

Muaath is a name of great symbolism and spiritual significance, reminding us to strive for truth and knowledge in our lives.
